gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-spline-san: Friendly from the first stroke, with curve tips that never quite touch. Playpen Sans Arabic wears its hand-drawn look openly, while Spline Sans, a sans with wide gaps and uniform strokes, keeps a short read comfortable.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-fs-synonym: Loose, friendly handwriting from Playpen Sans Arabic, its curve tips left open, with a drafting-pen steadiness running through every line. Synonym, a dependable sans-serif, keeps short reads easy going.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-arabic-outfit: Playpen Sans Arabic has a hand-drawn feel, its curve tips stopping short of each other like a drafting pen's line. Outfit, its cable-bent curves finishing early, adds clean order to the hand-drawn warmth, best for a few lines.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-deva-fs-neco: Graceful, pen-and-paper letters in Playpen Sans Deva flow outward, their terminals cut open and drawn with one fixed nib. Neco adds a dignified, gently swelling stroke, ideal for a few lines.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-deva-fs-spline-sans: Soft pen-and-paper charm, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward, drawn with one fixed nib. Spline Sans, with wide gaps and uniform strokes, steadies things, while Playpen Sans Deva earns its keep in big, short headings.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-deva-sora: Inviting and graceful, Playpen Sans Deva draws casual letters with one fixed nib, their terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Sora stays precise and geometric, built for brief lines, not long paragraphs.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-recia: Playpen Sans Thai draws flat, contrast-free letters, friendly and casual, with a clear opening at the end of every curve. Recia adds heavier verticals, like a tilted nib, best kept brief.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-rowan: Playpen Sans Thai draws neon-tube letters, every stroke glowing at one steady thickness, friendly and casual. Rowan, a literary serif with open curves and visible stroke contrast, keeps a few lines pleasant to read.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-fs-synonym: Friendly, casual scrawl: Playpen Sans Thai gives each stroke the same visual weight. Synonym lays down a plain stripe of constant ink, pleasant in modest helpings and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-playpen-sans-thai-outfit: Friendly and casual, Playpen Sans Thai gives every stroke matching heft, with a clear opening at each curve's end. Outfit bends cable-like lines into tidy curves, so a stretch of text glides.
